validated as (
    select
        cast(id as varchar) as campaign_id,
        campaign_type,
        created as created_at,
        email_template_id,
        lower(trim(from_email)) as from_email,
        from_name,

        send_time as scheduled_to_send_at,

        status,
        status_id,
        subject,
        updated as updated_at,
        archived as is_archived,
        scheduled as scheduled_at,

),
final as (
    select * from validated
)

tables.gold_staging_sql:
with base as (
    select * from raw.person
),

validated as (
    select
        cast(id as VARCHAR) as person_id,
        address_1,
        address_2,
        city,
        country,
        zip,
        created as created_at,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        latitude,
        longitude,
        organization,
        -- normalize phone number to a simple E.164-like form
        case
            when phone_number is null then null
            else
                case
                    when left(regexp_replace(phone_number, '[^0-9]+', ''), 1) = '0'
                        then '+' || ltrim(regexp_replace(phone_number, '[^0-9]+', ''), '0')
                    else '+' || regexp_replace(phone_number, '[^0-9]+', '')
                end
        end as phone_number,
        region,
        lower(trim(timezone)) as timezone,
        title,
        updated as updated_at,
        last_event_date,
        -- provide a constant source identifier for lineage
        'klaviyo' as source_relation
    from base
    where (email is null OR regexp_matches(lower(trim(email)), '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'))
),

final as (
    select
        person_id,
        address_1,
        address_2,
        city,
        country,
        zip,
        created_at,
        -- email length rule: nullify if too long
        case when email is not null and length(email) > 255 then null else lower(trim(email)) end as email,
        first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name,
        latitude,
        longitude,
        organization,
        phone_number,
        region,
        timezone,
        title,
        updated_at,
        last_event_date,
        source_relation
    from validated
)

select * from final
